entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你把乌克勒姆斯维奇和萨拉苏尔都杀掉了，同时背叛了他们两个。#WHITE#

entries.source: #Target# is weakened by the glyph of moonlight!

entries.target: 联合王国半身人巡逻队

entries.source: Before you stands a tall figure, propped high by a serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is slim and muscular, and his face has an elven beauty to it, framed by locks of blonde hair. But there is a fierceness to this creature too, and his bright eyes veil a smouldering anger.
entries.target: 在你的面前站着一位高大的生物，在他的腿部是像蛇一样的尾巴。他的身躯看起来高大威猛，并且他还有着一张精灵般美貌的脸庞和一头秀丽的长发。但同样的，这个生物也异常危险，你可以从他的眼睛中看到潜藏的愤怒。

entries.source: %s is confused and fails to use %s.

Until now, a certain game mechanic has been disabled. Go learn a new talent at the nearby Rune of Enlightenment and use it to blast each of the enemies in the next room. 

Can you identify the new mechanic?
entries.target:
到目前为止，某项游戏机制一直处于禁用状态。去附近的启蒙符文处学习一项新技能，
并用它轰击下一个房间里的每个敌人。

你能辨认出这项新机制吗？

entries.source: You tap into your golem's life energies to replenish your own. Drains %d life.
entries.target: 你汲取傀儡的生命能量来恢复自己。恢复 %d 点生命。
每回合受到 %0.2f 物理伤害

entries.source: Locks tooltip in place while comparing items
entries.target: 比较物品时锁定鼠标提示

entries.source:
Take an offensive stance. As you attack your foes, you knock your target and foes adjacent to them in a frontal arc back (up to %d grids).
		This consumes stamina rapidly (-1 stamina/turn).
entries.target:
采取猛攻姿态。攻击敌人时，会将目标以及正面弧线内与其相邻的敌人击退（最多 %d 格）。
		这个姿态会快速减少体力值（-1 体力/回合）。

entries.source: It's a large red ant, wreathed in flames.
entries.target: 一只巨大的红色蚂蚁，全身燃烧着火焰。

entries.source:
I fell into a trance, I know not how. Were it the rich blossoms or the oppressive heat? I swooned into the grass and the mists swirled over my face, playing out fantastic shapes before my eyes. Dancing ladies strode across the skies, and a row of dwarves stood laughing as their beards flew into the wind. Then I felt a Shadow near, and the ladies scattered and the dwarves in terror screamed, their mouths yowling and spilling black petals. I tried to move, but I couldn't, and frozen in fear I saw the Shadow above me, looking down upon my countenance. It grunted and lurched away. I passed out then, and have just recovered.

I am not sure what to make of this. I wish to leave, but I do not know the way. Only by escaping this mist shall I have a clear view of the land. Yet each path seems to wind unexpected, each step takes me closer to the centre, not further. I must make haste from this place.
entries.target:
我不知怎么陷入了恍惚。是繁茂的花朵，还是逼人的酷热？我昏倒在草丛里，雾气在我脸庞上方打着旋，在眼前演出种种奇景。起舞的女子跨过天空，一排矮人放声大笑，胡须迎风飞扬。随后我感觉一道阴影逼近，女子四散而逃，矮人惊恐尖叫，张开的嘴里一边哀号，一边涌出黑色花瓣。我想动，却动弹不得；我吓得僵在原地，看着那道阴影悬在上方，俯视我的面孔。它哼了一声，踉跄着离开。之后我便失去了意识，刚刚才醒来。

我不知道该如何理解这一切。我想离开，却不知道路在何方。只有逃出浓雾，我才能看清这片土地；可每条路都出人意料地迂回曲折，每一步都把我带向中心，而不是远离它。我必须尽快逃出这里。

entries.source: You can use shields or a second weapon in your off-hand, if you have the talents for it.
entries.target: 如果你有对应的技能，你可以副手使用盾牌或第二把武器。

entries.source: Offers either offensive or defensive benefits, depending on the position of the sands.  Switching the direction of flow takes no time.
entries.target: 根据沙的位置在进攻增益和防守增益间切换。切换沙的流向不消耗时间。

entries.source: Unlocked Archmage class and did over one million fire damage (with any item/talent/class).
entries.target: 解锁大法师职业并造成累计100万火焰伤害（使用任意物品/技能/职业）。

entries.source: You arrived in time and interrupted the ritual. The sorcerers have departed.
entries.target: 你终于及时赶来阻止了仪式，法师们被驱散了。

entries.source:
Creates a distortion wave in a radius %d cone that deals %0.2f physical damage and knocks back targets in the blast radius.
		This damage will distort affected targets, decreasing physical resistance by %d%% and rendering them vulnerable to distortion effects for two turns.
		Investing in this talent will increase the physical resistance reduction from all of your distortion effects.
		If the target is already distorted, they'll be stunned for %d turns as well.
		The damage will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
在 %d 码锥形半径范围内创建一股扭曲之涛，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，并击退扭曲之涛中的目标。
		此技能会扭曲目标，减少对方物理抗性 %d%%，并使其在 2 回合内受到扭曲效果时会产生额外的负面影响。
		在该技能投入点数会增加你所有扭曲效果的降抗效果。
		如果目标身上已存在扭曲效果，则会被震慑 %d 回合。
		受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

entries.source: Player can earn Nightmare version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
entries.target: 玩家如果选择永久死亡模式或冒险模式可以达成噩梦难度成就。

entries.source: This place is corrupted! I will cleanse it! Protect me while I do it!
entries.target: 这个地方被污染了！我会净化它的！请在我这么做的时候保护我！

entries.source:
Bite the target, dealing %d%% melee damage  
		If the attack hits you'll inject blight poison into the target, dealing %0.2f blight damage and a further %0.2f blight damage over 4 turns.
		The bonus damage improves with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
啃咬目标，造成 %d%% 近战伤害。
		如果攻击命中，你会向目标注入枯萎毒素，立即造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，并在 4 回合内再造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		额外伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source:
Each time you would take damage from someone else you gain one Spin, increasing your defense and saves by %d for three turns.
		This effect may occur once per turn and stacks up to three Spin (for a maximum bonus of %d).
entries.target:
每当你要受到其他人造成的伤害时，你编织一层命运之丝，使你的闪避和豁免增加 %d，持续三回合。
		这个效果每回合只能触发一次，丝能叠加三层 (加成最多为 %d)。

entries.source:
Activate the rune to become ethereal for %d turns.
		While ethereal all damage you deal is reduced by %d%%, you gain %d%% all resistance, you move %d%% faster, and you are invisible (power %d).
entries.target:
启动符文，使你变得虚幻，持续 %d 回合。
		在虚幻状态下，你造成的伤害减少 %d%%，你获得 %d%% 全体伤害抗性，你的移动速度提升 %d%%，你获得隐形 (强度 %d)。

entries.source:
These tiers are not just for show. 

Let's see if you can discover a way in which they're NOT purely cosmetic. Go plunder the room ahead!
entries.target:
这些不同颜色层级不仅仅是让数字显示起来好看一点。

看看你能否发现它们并非纯粹装饰的奥妙。前往并搜刮前方的房间吧！

entries.source: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
entries.target: 这是腐化泰坦的一部分沉重肢体，一大块腐烂的石化躯体。你认为你可以轻易举起它，但事实证明，它重的不可思议。

entries.source: Zone-wide effect: The flames of the Fearscape increase all fire and blight damage by 10%, but the weird gravity reduces knockback resistance by 20%.
entries.target: 地图效果 :  恶魔空间的火焰将增加 10% 火焰和枯萎伤害，同时减少 20% 击退抗性。

entries.source: Sharpen Visuals, set to 0 to disable.#WHITE#
#Target# is no longer manipulating the timestream.
Harness the power of blood, both your own and your foes'.
entries.target: 操纵你和你目标鲜血的力量。
嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡嗡。
